chars.MOM: MOM: a stern Moroccan woman in her early 60s wearing a dark green djellaba with gold trim, a white headscarf and thin gold-rimmed glasses
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan man in his early 30s with a short black beard, wearing a burgundy zip windbreaker over a white t-shirt and dark jeans
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her mid 20s with long dark hair tied back, wearing a light blue denim jacket over a long beige dress
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a Moroccan woman in her late 20s wearing a mustard yellow hoodie, black trousers and a black headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A modest Moroccan living room in Fes with blue-patterned sedari sofas. Seen from where her son sits facing her, head-to-waist: MOM leans forward on the sofa, pointing a finger and complaining with an angry, disapproving face, mid-sentence. Face clearly visible, centered, calm background at the edges. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: View from inside a Fes apartment window looking down at the street: WIFE walks out of the building with her long hair uncovered, books under her arm, smiling; in the foreground MOM peeks from behind the curtain with a sharp disapproving frown. Both faces visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room: SISTER sits next to MOM on the sedari sofa whispering gossip into her ear with a sly smile, MOM nods with raised eyebrows. Head-to-waist, faces visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A bedroom in a Fes apartment: MOM holds up a modern colourful blouse taken from a wardrobe, inspecting it with disgust and suspicion, mouth open as if asking 'where did she get this?'. Face visible, centered, wardrobe in the background. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits alone on the edge of a sofa in a Moroccan living room, rubbing his forehead, thinking hard, torn between two sides, a family photo frame on the wall behind him. Head-to-waist, face visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Small bedroom in a Fes apartment at evening: NARRATOR gently holds WIFE's hands and talks softly to her, asking a favour with a pleading face; WIFE listens, a little hurt but patient, a folded beige headscarf on the bed beside her. Faces visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan kitchen: WIFE smiles warmly and offers MOM a glass of mint tea on a small silver tray; MOM keeps her arms crossed and turns her face away coldly. Faces visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a hallway doorway: in a Moroccan living room, WIFE passes by carrying university books, while MOM sitting on the sofa follows her with a long hateful side-glare. Faces visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room: MOM grabs NARRATOR by the sleeve of his burgundy windbreaker and scolds him angrily, wagging her finger in his face; NARRATOR looks tired and cornered. Head-to-waist, faces visible, centered. No text.
